# OllaSuper — AI Workforce Platform
> Your company. Powered by AI employees.

OllaSuper is an enterprise AI Workforce Platform that enables businesses to deploy autonomous AI employees across Market Research, Outbound Sales, Technical Marketing, Tier-2 Customer Support, and Business Operations.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous AI Employees**: Specialized personas with persistent memory, tool-calling capabilities, and deterministic execution pipelines.
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP)**: Universal connector framework supporting 100+ integrations (Salesforce, HubSpot, Stripe, PostgreSQL, Notion, GitHub, Slack).
- **Human-in-the-Loop Governance**: Granular policy gates requiring 1-click human authorization for high-risk write actions.
- **Deep Observability**: Millisecond-level flamegraph tracing, token cost accounting, and PII redaction.
- **Deterministic Evaluation**: Golden dataset benchmarking with 250+ assertions before production deployment.

## Available AI Employees
- **Research Employee** (`/ai-employees/research`): Autonomous Market & Competitor Intelligence Analyst.
- **Sales Employee** (`/ai-employees/sales`): Autonomous Outbound SDR & Pipeline Specialist.
- **Marketing Employee** (`/ai-employees/marketing`): Autonomous Content Strategist & Growth Operator.
- **Customer Support Employee** (`/ai-employees/customer-support`): Autonomous Tier-1/2 Technical Support Specialist.
- **Operations Employee** (`/ai-employees/operations`): Autonomous Business Operations & Ledger Orchestrator.
- **Custom Employee** (`/ai-employees/custom`): User-defined autonomous agent with private MCP server support.
